prompt: A desktop web app screen, edge to edge, crisp readable text, no browser window or device. Navigation sits in a dark navy top bar (channels as tabs), no left rail. Under it a 'needs you' band holds the review task as a wide card with its buttons; below, the chat takes two thirds and a compact task list one third. Review-led. Product: Hive, a team workspace where people chat in channels and one shared AI agent does tasks on its own computer. The visitor's job: see what the agent is doing, answer it, and review finished work before it goes out. Workspace: Fern & Fig (a plant shop). Channels: launch, design, ops, hiring, plus Chat, Tasks, Files, Goals, Computer. Badge '2 need you'. Content: #launch chat (Priya: 'Photos are in, hero is the maidenhair fern.'; Marcus: '@hive what do we still need before the send?' then the agent's short reply listing what is left). Tasks: 'Write the launch email' (agent, ready for your review, 18m, due Fri, buttons Mark done and Send back); 'Set up the pre-order page' (agent, running, 42m); 'Order 8-inch boxes' (failed, supplier out of stock); 'Brief support on pre-order questions' (Dana, to do). The Hive bee mark appears in the top left. The brand palette is pinned and must be used: dark navy #031D44, medium blue #1C4768, bright blue #22B1E0, teal green #1CCC80, light cyan #91E4E7, light gray #EEF2F5. Navy for structure and text, bright blue for primary actions and the person's attention, teal green for done and the agent's presence, light cyan for selection tint, light gray for page ground; a muted red only for failure. Calm, precise, a quiet lowercase grotesque, round status dots, generous spacing, matte, no metal, no gradients, standard web controls.
